fact: The Controller and Auditor General found that 16 local government authorities collected TZS 6.68 billion in FY2023/24 through the discontinued LGRCIS instead of TAUSI, after PO-RALG's 31 January 2023 instruction to install TAUSI by 31 March 2023.
title: Annual General Report for Audit of PO-RALG, Regional Administrations and Local Government Authorities, FY 2023/24
